notes: Facechecked remotes with 2-3 credits and no fitting breaker, then sat on 20-29 credits clicking for credits for turns 7-8 while the Corp advanced and scored agendas in two remotes.
Scored steadily, but left Remote Enforcement behind one ice at 0 credits (stolen), iced four empty remotes, and clicked for credits at 20-28 credits while discarding to hand size.
After turn 4 it did almost nothing but click for credits up to 52, never contesting the remote where the Corp advanced and scored three agendas over several turns.

An 8-credit Tollbooth rez left it on 0-3 credits for six turns, R&D stayed open long enough to lose AstroScript, and it advanced agendas over two turns behind a single Pop-up Window while drawing and discarding to hand size.
Coherent pressure: stole from a weak remote twice, then kept running R&D through Enigma with Aumakua to win; the only real slip was facechecking R&D on 1 credit.

With the Runner broke and locked out by IP Block, it clicked for credits for about ten turns up to 27, discarding every turn (Project Beale was stolen from Archives), and only started scoring on turn 17.
Smart Paparazzi plus Data Leak Reversal mill plan, finished with Archives runs; it lost Eater to a turn-1 facecheck on 2 credits and made a few low-value Archives runs.
After hitting Snare it ran R&D again on 3 cards and 1 credit against Weyland, hit a second Snare, and ended the turn with 0 cards and 2 tags, a foreseeable Scorched Earth flatline.

Spent most of the game on 0-3 credits while holding Melange Mining Corp in HQ uninstalled, forfeited Posted Bounty for a tag it could not use, and paid scarce credits to trash runner resources; it won only because the Runner stopped contesting the remote.

Never iced HQ all game, left R&D open early, and lost Hostile Takeover and Global Food Initiative from an unprotected HQ, while clicking for credits at 14-20 and holding Commercial Bankers Group and Jeeves for many turns.
The Runner ran an open R&D four times every turn and the Corp never iced it, instead clicking for credits and playing IPO up to 30 credits until three agendas were stolen.

Solid overall (trashed Marilyn Campaigns, stole from HQ and remotes, finished on R&D), but it ran the same naked Marilyn server five times over two turns without trashing it and paid repeatedly to reinstall Paperclip.

Clicked for credits for six turns up to 24 while discarding, then put two agendas in turn behind a single Vanilla the Runner had already broken (both stolen) and discarded Project Vitruvius to an open Archives, losing the game.

Banked 43 credits clicking for credits while its grip was shredded by repeated runs into Yagura and Komainu; at 6 points it ignored a fresh agenda remote and went into Jinteki's scoring turn holding 1 card, a foreseeable flatline.

A good start gave way to running the same known Urtica Cipher server four more times, losing Unity, Cleaver and most of its grip, while never contesting the remote where the Corp scored three agendas.
Kept installing agendas in fresh naked remotes (three Fetal AI and one Gila Hands, all stolen) while its iced Server 3 sat empty, and spent many turns clicking for credits.
Mostly passive: long stretches of clicking for credits and empty Archives runs while the Corp scored four agendas out of one remote, with little pressure beyond occasional R&D runs.
Hansei Review trashed Obokata Protocol into an open Archives, giving away 3 points, and it clicked for credits at 16-21 for several turns, though it used its remote well to score out.
Reasonable economy and a nice Seamless Launch score, but it put agendas behind a single Diviner (Offworld Office stolen) and kept advancing over several turns behind that same weak ice.
Got to 5 points by turn 3 on an open R&D, then from turn 11 only clicked for credits up to 33 while the Corp scored four agendas behind a single Enigma; one steal would have won.
